result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.get_degree()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Get the degree of a node. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L13617-L13684){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.get_degree(node) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} For directed graphs, returns total degree (in-degree + out-degree). For undirected graphs, returns the number of neighbors. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [node]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Union[int, str]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Node ID or label. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [int]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Degree of the node. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Get node degree in undirected graph: ::: {#fd5fb986 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_node(label="A") .add_node(label="B") .add_node(label="C") .add_edge("A", "B") .add_edge("A", "C") ) # Returns 2 graph.get_degree("A") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` 2 ``` ::: ::: ::: {#00229bb2 .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} # Returns 1 graph.get_degree("B") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` 1 ``` ::: ::: In directed graphs, counts both incoming and outgoing: ::: {#67c50cce .cell execution_count=3} ``` {.python .cell-code} graph = ( ec.Graph(directed=True) .add_node(label="A") .add_node(label="B") .add_node(label="C") .add_edge("A", "B") # A -> B (out for A, in for B) .add_edge("C", "A") # C -> A (in for A) ) # Returns 2 (1 in + 1 out) graph.get_degree("A") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=3} ``` 2 ``` ::: :::
